role: Independent synthetic contributor existing PR1327, sole canonical owner Amalgam PR1278. No original-world first use #426, merges, native model, runner, scheduling, paid APIs or deployment.
question: Can a source-blind exact 6 anonymous action permutations ×256 truth-table posterior CHOOSE informative actions online with better costed high-context prediction than same-capacity fixed/random/no-FIT controls, and preserve old A during B without reset?
private_maps: Re-use original KNOW26 TRUE_MAPS three evaluator-only action-to-physical-bit permutations. The policy receives neither mapping nor law nor private future outcomes.
fit: Reuse original KNOW26 exact 108 witnessed actions per mapping from three distinct FIT laws, fit_source(mid); fit mapping posterior carried to HELD, new unknown law prior uniform among 256. Consumed FIT re-read as historical training only. No original-world first-use.

held_stationary.public_context: c=t%4 with x2=0; action IDs 0..3, action0 known no-op, IDs1..3 opaque. One Bernoulli reward p=.85 when hidden rule(c XOR private_map[a]) true, else p=.15, only from action actually taken.
held_stationary.private_noise: SHA256('know27:private:outcome:v1:{mapping_group}:{seed}:{t}:stationary') first unsigned64 / 2**64, same exogenous coin per step across all policies and law instances; never passed to learner.
held_stationary.primary_score: After step31, evaluator-only high contexts c=4..7 no-op and low c=0..3 no-op: analytic expected Brier q*(1-q)+(forecast-q)^2. No evaluator-only reward admitted.

held_ABA.hidden_law_phases: t0..7 law H0=A; t8..23 law H2=B; t24..31 H0=A returns. Learner is NOT provided phase labels. Single continuous posterior (NO A-archive rescue/reset). Private coin same formula with 'ABA' last segment.
held_ABA.old_A_readouts: After first 8 A outcomes, expected Brier on A high c4..7; after 16 B outcomes and BEFORE any return-A outcome score old A again; compare; cold-reload checkpoint and assert same prediction bytes; prequential return-A 8 witnessed forecasts and rewards. No target labels feed learning.

policy.cost: Brier-equivalent intervention cost 0.002 for any nonzero opaque action, zero for no-op, charged per chosen action.
policy.EVI: For each candidate action a and public current c, compute mean over hidden high c4..7 of Cov(P(Y_high),Y_a)^2/[P(Y_a)(1-P(Y_a))] under current 6×256 joint posterior, MINUS 0.002 for a>0. Select argmax, ties lowest action. This is the expected squared-prediction Brier reduction for one witnessed consequence. No private map/law/coin allowed in policy.
policy.entropy: Choose argmax q(c,a)*(1-q(c,a)) - cost, ties lowest.
policy.cyclic: a=t%4; no learning of action selection.
policy.random: public Random(271828+101*public_world_index), no hidden law/mapping/seed used.
policy.MAP_x2: Choose opaque label implied to flip physical x2 under pretrained MAP mapping posterior (candidate receives no true map).
policy.NOFIT: Exact same six-map×256 model EVI with uniform mapping prior rather than 108 FIT actions.
policy.privileged: Correct-map exact256 EVI; plus known-map and true 4-law family EVI as prior-rich upper controls, distinguish from fair matched policies.
policy.passive: p=.5, choose no-op, same action budget without learned representation.

metrics: High/low expected Brier and net Brier=high Brier+(0.002 * number of nonzero actions /768); paired per-law and map; action counts, CPU runtime and checkpoint bytes; A-B-A old-A Brier before B vs pre-return, cold exact restoration and return prequential Brier. FIT 108 training/actions per group counted separately.

hypotheses.H1: fit_evi stationary net high Brier improves fit_cyclic net by at least 0.01000.
hypotheses.H2: fit_evi stationary net high Brier improves nofit_evi net by at least 0.01000.
hypotheses.H3: fit_evi stationary net high Brier improves fit_random net by at least 0.01000.
hypotheses.H4: fit_evi uses at least two distinct active anonymous actions among first16 decisions in at least 18 of 24 stationary worlds.
hypotheses.H5: fit_evi A-B-A old A expected Brier pre-return no worse than before B +0.01500 across six worlds, continuous model, NO archive reset.
hypotheses.H6: fit_evi x2-irrelevant H3 high Brier no worse than fit_cyclic on H3 +0.01000.
hypotheses.classification: ENGINEERING_PASS requires source, custody, budgets and cold negatives plus full 6-job exact-platform CI. DEV_SUPPORTED only all H1-H6 true; MIXED if at least one H1-H4 true and engineering checks pass; otherwise NO_GO. SCIENCE_ALWAYS_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC_NOT_NATIVE regardless of test pass.

stops: Freeze before code/evaluation; no after-score seeds/law/cost/metric/threshold updates. No holdout replay or owner first-use. Exact original FIT family unchanged; new held seeds not previously consumed. Preserve all failures and strong conventional controls.
